purpose: Performance-only encoded static-row loader experiment; no retrieval/model/threshold/representation tuning
candidate: Retain owned safetensors bytes and decode only used F16/F32/I8 rows. No mmap/unsafe/model-file dependency after loading. Preserve original tokenizer/unknown/remapping/scaling/mean/double-normalization semantics.
equivalence_gate: Compare every f32 bit, dimensions, model identity and input-cap/batch semantics on authored malformed/valid tensor fixtures and fixed real-model multilingual/long/code/document texts plus own-source chunks. No approximate quality substitute or gold-dependent tuning. Eager production path remains until proof.
measurements: Sequential fresh startup and OS model-only/peak memory, fixed resident fill/warm calls, bridge inference on query/short/long/mixed batches; repeat fresh profiles for outliers. Preserve errors/negative candidates. No concurrent numerical processes.
selection: Prefer encoded only with exact supported-model equivalence and material startup/peak-memory benefit; measure JIT throughput and cached resident costs explicitly. Any significant throughput regression may keep eager as default or require an explicit supported tradeoff rather than hiding cost. No fixed success claim from one machine or cold executable sample.
limits: No low-end hardware proof. Consumed Gate10 held-out not reused as untouched tuning set. Current default model attribution/ADS/xattr payload unchanged.
